definitions.explanation: The game of spinning tops, traditionally played by children at New Year. Also a performing art in which skilled players make tops balance on swords, strings, or fans.

examples.japanese: {独楽|こま}{回|まわ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦お{正月|しょうがつ}→お正月：05586_oshougatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{独楽|こま}{回|まわ}し⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んだ→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: We played with spinning tops at New Year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{独楽|こま}{回|まわ}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{得意|とくい}→得意：03455_tokui⟧で、⟦{手|て}のひら→手のひら：05294_tenohira⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{回|まわ}せる→回す：01158_mawasu⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather is good at spinning tops; he can even spin one on his palm.

notes:
Often written こま{回|まわ}し or コマ{回|まわ}し. A top is wound with a string and thrown so that the string sets it spinning.

CULTURAL NOTE:
Top spinning is one of the classic New Year games (⟦お{正月|しょうがつ}→お正月：05586_oshougatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{遊|あそ}び→遊び：01285_asobi⟧), together with ⟦{凧揚|たこあ}げ→凧揚げ：07128_takoage⟧ (kite flying), {羽根突|はねつ}き (battledore and shuttlecock) and ⟦{福笑|ふくわら}い→福笑い：07130_fukuwarai⟧. A top that spins steadily was a symbol of a smooth-running year.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{独楽|こま}→独楽：10104_koma⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回|まわ}す→回す：01158_mawasu⟧: to spin a top
- ⟦{独楽|こま}→独楽：10104_koma⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧: a top spins
- {喧嘩独楽|けんかごま}: fighting tops (knocking each other out of a ring)
